# telnyx_email_domain_webhooks (Data Source)

Lists email domain webhooks, with optional filters. Each item has the attributes of `telnyx_email_domain_webhook`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain_id` (String) The domain id.

### Optional

- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.
- `sort` (String) One of `-created_at`, `created_at`.

### Read-Only

- `email_domain_webhooks` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--email_domain_webhooks))

<a id="nestedatt--email_domain_webhooks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `email_domain_webhooks`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String)
- `domain_id` (String)
- `events` (Set of String) Allowlist of event types delivered to this webhook. At least one event is required — there is no default-to-all.
- `id` (String)
- `record_type` (String)
- `updated_at` (String)
- `url` (String) HTTPS endpoint to deliver subscribed events to.
